text:
marta: heads-up: we're splitting transit privileges tonight so unwrap/wrap ops live under transit-unwrap and admin changes under transit-admin. staging-only first. window 21:30 UTC. posting plan here for visibility.
ash: which service accounts are in scope? any customer-facing degradation risk?
marta: staging SAs: image-builder, model-harness, data-sync. No customer-facing services in prod. plan: 1) create transit-unwrap policy, 2) bind minimal k8s roles, 3) run canary unwraps (500), 4) tail audit logs for 403/5xx, 5) promote.
leo: recommend pre-wired emergency fallback role bound to the three SAs with short TTL so we can avoid broad admin grants if things fail.
ash: we have ~150 long-lived archived blobs that depend on the existing unwrap path. i'll run a rewrap job prior to the change and verify checksums.
devsec-bot: ticket SEC-9991 opened for this rollout and will collect audit artifacts.
marta: Splunk query i'll use to spot permission failures:
```
index=vault_logs source=transit action=unwrap | stats count as attempts by service_account, response_code | where response_code!=200
```
leo: agree with manual rollback only. i'll prepare a terraform snippet to reapply previous bindings quickly. also i'll put a small runbook step to rebind old role in case we need to bounce.
marta: rollback CLI snippet:```
# rebind old policy to k8s role
vault write auth/kubernetes/role/model-harness-role policies=transit-default
```
oncall-bot: creating ephemeral alert rule unwrap-failure-agg:threshold=10 window=5m -> slack + page oncall.
ash: i'll kick off the rewrap batch for archived tokens and post progress here.
marta: canary started 21:30 UTC: ran 500 unwraps across image-builder and model-harness, 0 permission-denied responses. moving to full staging roll.
marta: 21:44 UTC - after promoting to all staging namespaces we saw 3 permission-denied unwraps from data-sync SA (timestamps logged). attached data-sync-fallback role (TTL=4h) and re-ran 50 validation unwraps; all passed. logged actions in SEC-9991.
nash: rewrap job completed at 21:50 UTC: 150 blobs rewrapped and checksum verified. recorded artifact in ticket.
leo: oncall still watching. if we see >15 failures in 10m we escalate.
marta: removing fallback role 22:15 UTC. scheduling 72h post-change monitoring and an RBAC diff audit.
ash: i'll produce CSV of principals that actually invoked unwrap in the last 24h and diff against bound roles, and upload to SEC-9991.
leo: follow-ups: add an automated preflight job that runs N unwraps as part of policy changes, and add pre-provisioned short-TTL fallback roles to the change template. also update runbook with exact Splunk queries and rollback snippets.
marta: final: rollout stable. closing SEC-9991 as resolved, attaching audit events and canary logs. thanks all. :thumbsup:
devsec-bot: policy-change event recorded (actor=marta, policy=transit-unwrap, change_id=ab-12345).
